categories.title: Google AI & Creative Studios
categories.description: Publication-grade 12-page visual handbooks covering Google AI Ultra's creative studios, agentic coding IDEs, source-grounded research tools, and autonomous browser workflows.

guides.title: Google Flow
guides.subtitle: Cinematic AI filmmaking studio powered by Veo 3.1, Ingredients consistency, Frames-to-Video transitions, and Scenebuilder.

guides.title: Google Antigravity & Jules
guides.subtitle: Agent-first desktop IDE, parallel subagents, skills/MCP customization, and asynchronous GitHub PR automation with Jules.

guides.title: Google Whisk
guides.subtitle: Image-first visual remixing studio blending Subject, Scene & Style cards, hidden Gemini captions, Seed locking, and Whisk Animate.

guides.title: Google Vids
guides.subtitle: Workspace AI video presentation studio turning Docs & Slides into narrated storyboards with AI voiceovers, avatars, teleprompter, and Veo B-roll.

guides.title: Google Stitch
guides.subtitle: AI-native UI/UX design studio turning prompts, sketches, and screenshots into multi-screen flows, Figma Auto-Layout frames, and Tailwind code.

guides.title: Google Opal
guides.subtitle: Visual no-code AI mini-app studio chaining Gemini, Imagen, Veo, Lyria, and Web Search nodes into shareable interactive apps.

guides.title: Google AI Studio
guides.subtitle: Flagship Gemini developer & power-user workbench for 1M+ token video/PDF analysis, Stream Realtime screen share, Build vibe-coding, and SDKs.

guides.title: Google NotebookLM
guides.subtitle: Zero-hallucination research studio for 500+ sources, live interactive Join Audio Overviews, Video Overviews, and clickable Mind Maps.

guides.title: Gemini Deep Research, Canvas & Gems
guides.subtitle: Autonomous multi-hundred-site research dossiers, split-screen Canvas live apps with embedded AI, and custom Drive-synced Gems.

guides.title: Google Project Mariner
guides.subtitle: Autonomous browser-use agent & Gemini Agent Mode running up to 10 parallel cloud browsers, Teach & Repeat skills, and safety gates.
